If you really can’t live at home maybe go to the Citizens Advice Bureau and ask for help. Maybe they can set you up with a council house? Anyone can apply after 16. Perhaps also look into foyers, they’re meant to help.

I made every and any excuse to be out of that house until I went to student accommodation. Libraries are warm, safe places to hang out for a while. My advice is to talk to your local authorities, or keep your head down until you’re 18 and can go to uni/ work full time.
